After the rewire onBack calls ChatsController.closeChatFeed(); in that test ChatsController.selectChat is stubbed, so store.selectedChat stays undefined, and Store.set('selectedChat', undefined) over undefined does not emit (utils/Store.ts:111-117, changed=false): the withChats handler never runs, the CDU guard (chat.ts:630-636) never fires, props.chatPaneOpen stays true and the assertion at line 138 fails on the first npm test run.

rounds.summary: Full round vs code at 1cbdbc8. Root cause confirmed: chat.ts:408 derives chatPaneOpen from store selectedChat, onBack (chat.ts:454-456) clears only the local prop, and Router destroys the page on route change (utils/Router.ts:96; chat.ts CDM comment 695-698), so the bottom-bar return mounts a fresh page that re-derives chatPaneOpen=true from the stale store selection. Fix sound: closeChatFeed number->undefined store.set always emits (utils/Store.ts:98-120), the withChats mapper passes selectedChat into props (chat.ts:755) and returns a fresh chats reference on every emit, so the CDU guard (chat.ts:630-636) collapses exactly once in the same store-emit cycle (the follow-up CDU sees undefined->undefined and skips; Store.set of undefined over undefined is a no-op emit-wise - see PR-1 for the test-only consequence). Regressions checked: chat_deleted (controller.ts:374), leaveChat (write at controller.ts:764), openDm preselect (features/index.ts:48-52 into chat.ts:404-408) and repeated onSelectChat (chat.ts:447-452) are untouched by the rewire; bottom-bar return without back stays the deliberate openDm behavior; messenger.test.ts has no onBack/chatPaneOpen surface (chat.hbs:26 passes onBack through unchanged). Ownership sufficient: messenger wiring needs no change, forbidden list protects utils/core/messenger/backend. Tier S1 honest: single owner, one behavioral seam, budgets (maxTaskAttempts 2, one review round, no final audit) fit a quick-change. Verdict READY_TO_FREEZE with two non-blocking findings. Freeze-binding: after this verdict the author applied exactly two review-driven edits (plan.md header S0->S1 per PR-2; plan.manifest.json planReview.verdict PENDING->READY_TO_FREEZE as the verdict mirror) with no other manifest bytes changed; the recomputed sha256 of the resulting plan.manifest.json (trailing LF excluded) is bd8dfc52a4a56536c9871a313139a9c6febdf487ff8d6135308cf375a42eab52 and reviewedPlanHash is re-pinned to it; verdict READY_TO_FREEZE confirmed for this state.
